module: GE extension that tracks a scenario's statistics (distance traveled, altitude, max speed, damage, time, goals) for each vehicle, computes the points earned and awards the final medal (wood/bronze/silver/gold). The parameters come from scenario.statistics (maxValue, maxPoints, best/worst, target, source, required, alias, overall with goldCutoff/silverCutoff/bronzeCutoff). A modder uses it to read a scenario's results (getVehicleStat, getScenarioOverallStat) or to add their own statistics (initialiseArbitraryStat, setStatProgress).
usage:
local stats = statistics_statistics.getVehicleStat(be:getPlayerVehicleID(0))
for _, s in ipairs(stats or {}) do print(s.label, s.value, s.points, s.maxPoints) end
notes: The internal tables are keyed by vehicle id then by key 'stat_<name>' or 'goal_<name>'; each entry contains 'instances' (one per source/tracked vehicle).
Units: distance and altitude in meters; if the total is < 1609.34 m (1 mile) the displayed unit is 'm', otherwise the user's 'distance' unit. Speed (max) is the norm of map.objects[id].vel in m/s.
Points of a stat: (value / maxValue) * maxPoints, or, for time, linear interpolation between best (max points) and worst (0). Points are clamped to ±maxPoints then rounded with math.floor.
Medal: wood if the scenario is failed; gold if score >= goldCutoff (default 90%) or maxPoints == 0; silver >= silverCutoff (70); bronze >= bronzeCutoff (0).
Probable BUG: in initialiseTimeStat, when scenario.statistics.time is an array, maxPoints/best/worst are read from the array (timeProperties) and not from the current entry (entry), so they are nil.
Probable BUG: getSummaryStats adds data.points / data.maxPoints without a nil check (error if the name does not exist in scenarioStats).
DEBUG_generateScoreForMedal does clamp(percent, 0, 100) while percent is already a fraction 0..1; the game logs errors in shipping builds because the function should be removed.

enableStatisticTracking calls vehicle:getPosition() without testing vehicle for nil and writes initialZPos/initialPos on statEntry (and not on the instance) while onUpdate reads instance.initialPos/initialZPos.

reset.desc: Clears scenarioStats (per-scenario summaries). Does not touch statsTable.

enableStatisticTracking.desc: Enables tracking of a statistic for a vehicle (enabled = true) and stores the starting position for 'altitude' (initialZPos) or 'distance' (initialPos). Does nothing if the statistic does not exist for this vehicle.

disableStatisticTracking.desc: Disables tracking of a statistic for a vehicle (enabled = false). Values already measured are kept.

getScenarioOverallStat.desc: Returns the overall summary of a scenario (label, points, maxPoints, failed, medal...), or an empty table if there is none.

getVehicleStat.desc: Builds the list of a vehicle's statistics for the end-of-scenario interface: one entry per stat/goal with label, decimals, unit, predefinedUnit, required, failed, value, points, maxPoints and relativePoints (in %). Aggregates the instances (sum of values and points). For a '%' unit, the value is brought back to value/maxValue*100.

returns.desc: List of entries, or nil if the vehicle has no stats.

getSummaryStats.desc: Returns, in the given order, the summaries of several scenarios (with relativePoints in %) as well as the total points earned and the total max points. Used for a campaign recap.

setGoalProgress.desc: Creates or updates the progress of a goal (key 'goal_<name>', required = true) for a vehicle: records the instance's points and maxPoints and failed if goalData.status == 'failed'. Does nothing if the vehicle does not yet have a stats table.

instanceId.desc: Instance identifier (often the id of the goal's target vehicle).

setStatProgress.desc: Creates or updates a statistic for a vehicle. The fields decimals, enabled, label, predefinedUnit, unit and isGoal are stored at the stat level; all other statData fields (value, maxValue, maxPoints, source...) are copied into the instance instanceId. Ignored if instanceId or statData is missing or not a table.

initialiseArbitraryStat.desc: Adds a custom statistic (value = 0, decimals = 2, enabled) to a vehicle; the source is vehicleName.

vehicleName.desc: Vehicle name, used as source and instance id.

stopStatsGathering.desc: End of collection: chooses the distance/altitude unit (m if < 1609.34 m, otherwise 'distance' unit), computes the player vehicle's points and fills the scenario summary (points, maxPoints, failed, medal).

getMedalRanking.desc: Converts a medal name to a rank: wood 0, bronze 1, silver 2, gold 3; -1 if unknown.

DEBUG_generateScoreForMedal.desc: Debug function: forces the player's score to a percentage just above the requested medal's threshold and fills the current scenario's summary.

onRaceGoalsInitilised.desc: Hook: called when the race goals are initialized. Recreates the stats tables (initialiseTables). The name contains the typo 'Initilised'.

onScenarioRestarted.desc: Hook: called when the scenario restarts; recreates the stats tables.

onScenarioChange.desc: Hook: called on each scenario state change. In the 'post' state, captures the final damage of each vehicle (map.objects[id].damage).

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame. While scenario.raceState == 'racing' (and state ≠ 'post'), updates distance (norm of the displacement since initialPos), altitude (absolute Z difference) and max speed for each tracked vehicle.

onRaceInit.desc: Hook: called when the race is initialized; records the starting position (initialPos, initialZPos) of the distance and altitude stats.

onRaceTick.desc: Hook: called on each race tick; records the current timer in the 'time' stat.

onRaceResult.desc: Hook: called at the end of the race; records status.finalTime in the 'time' stat.

onSerialize.desc: Extension save hook: returns statsTable (id keys converted to vehicle names) and scenarioStats.

onDeserialized.desc: Reload hook: restores statsTable (names converted back to ids) and scenarioStats.

onSaveCampaign.desc: Campaign save hook: passes the same data as onSerialize to saveCallback.

onResumeCampaign.desc: Campaign resume hook: restores statsTable and scenarioStats from data.
